selection_rule: G0 + task-required r04 + unique original HERO in uncovered B1 and B4; no mesh inspection
mask: native nearest categorical mask: only finite positive label1; zero otherwise; no far-depth unknown; no CAD/E3C filtering
CAD: black geometry for diagnostics/rendering; never integrated, never used for post-hoc deletion
ROI: inherited frame; no clipping of source or TSDF geometry

parameter_basis.noise_proxy_origin: E3B finite band, not calibrated sensor noise; no GT
parameter_basis.voxel_choice: 0.1 mm comparable to native pixel spacing
parameter_basis.trunc_choice: 4 voxels; larger than inherited 0.25 mm uncertainty proxy; unvalidated science parameter

optional_resolution_control.trigger: single-source p95 native-ray error >0.2 mm OR native valid-depth hit fraction <0.90, after adapter algebra checks pass; this would diagnose discretization, not replace primary G0/G1

engineering_gate.scope: interface fidelity only; no anatomical accuracy claim

evaluation.original_face_sampling: linspace fixed original Face ID; all original face centroids for preservation metric
evaluation.case_selection: source with largest CORE loss (G0), largest G1-G0 area-retention decrease, largest G1-G0 increase; deterministic ties source order
evaluation.Unknown: output with no original source agreeing in finite image Mask and axial depth within 0.25 mm; no physical truth implied
